title: Toolbar
description: Fiori toolbar with priority-based overflow, stable arbitrary items, spacers, separators and UI5 arrow-key navigation.

usage.summary: Group related actions and controls in a horizontal row with keyboard navigation and responsive overflow.
useWhen: Let users act on page content or selected items from one labeled group of controls.
Keep secondary controls reachable through an overflow popover when the available width shrinks.
Use overflowPriority="neverOverflow" on ToolbarButton or ToolbarItem for main actions that must remain visible.

avoidWhen.when: Arrange a header or footer with independent start, centered and end content without toolbar navigation or overflow.
Provide product branding and global search, notifications or profile access on every screen.
